stages.title: Freeze sampling contracts and witnesses
stages.note: Pure NumPy decoding, keyed RNG, log-weight, projection, and accounting contracts are frozen against analytical and authenticated E3 witnesses.

stages.title: Expose a portable TabICL distribution API
stages.note: NumPy-only batched ICDF/log-density evaluation is exposed through explicit capabilities; historical nine-quantile generation replays exactly offline.

stages.title: Trace feature distributions through classifiers
stages.note: E12 now has a single-pass fixed-state trace, externally checked per-action inventory, resumable matrix-cell driver, and factual/seed-clustered stratified analysis.

stages.title: Integrate budgeted q decoders
stages.note: E11 mode, exact grid, IID, top-k, and top-p decoders now enforce raw/scoring budgets with keyed RNG and fully dereferenceable proposal traces.

stages.title: Integrate classifier-guided pi-beta sampling
stages.note: E13 common-pool SIR and classifier-top-B now use exact q draws, cached oracle scores, common random numbers, and portable guidance/accounting traces.

stages.title: Freeze identities, matrices, and launchers
stages.note: New v4/v2 identities, partition-qualified factual selection, exact E11-E13 specs, authorization-gated launchers, and external campaign seals are frozen and independently verified.

stages.title: Run authorized diagnostics and validation pilots
